description: Header file defining the QuicCoalescedPacket class used for buffering and coalescing multiple QUIC packets into a single UDP datagram.

classes.name: QuicCoalescedPacket
classes.description: A class for buffering multiple coalesced QUIC packets, managing their addresses, lengths, and encryption levels.

methods.name: MaybeCoalescePacket
methods.description: Attempts to coalesce a new packet with existing buffered packets.

methods.name: CopyEncryptedBuffers
methods.description: Copies encrypted buffers to a provided buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the coalesced packet.

methods.name: ContainsPacketOfEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Checks if the buffer contains a packet of a specific encryption level.

methods.name: TransmissionTypeOfPacket
methods.description: Gets the transmission type for a specific encryption level.

methods.name: NumberOfPackets
methods.description: Returns the number of packets in the buffer.

methods.name: initial_packet
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the initial packet if present.

methods.name: self_address
methods.description: Returns the self address associated with the coalesced packet.

methods.name: peer_address
methods.description: Returns the peer address associated with the coalesced packet.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the total length of the coalesced packet.

methods.name: max_packet_length
methods.description: Returns the maximum packet length allowed.

methods.name: packet_lengths
methods.description: Returns a vector of individual packet lengths.
